topic: Data source location and shapefile acquisition
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered technical issues related to data processing, specifically a temporary table (`reaggr_agg_temp`) disappearing during a query in the recalculation process. A separate discussion focused on identifying the source of demographic zone data (`_demographics_sogne_dk`), which was noted as being imported without clear country-specific sources.

Regarding geographical data, it was confirmed that while two files were used for all countries (one from GitHub and one API endpoint), the necessary shapefiles could not be sourced from standard channels and had to be acquired elsewhere.
decisions: The source of demographic zone data needs further investigation/data acquisition.
action_items: Someone needs to investigate or acquire additional demographic data.
